verdict.rationale: ChatGPT documents installable plugins that connect it to third-party tools: Slack, Google Drive, SharePoint, Salesforce, Gong and Codex Security. It also offers workspace apps and connected apps for GPTs, and lets users add MCP servers such as Context7. That covers the 'add third-party connectors' half of the story, but no evidence describes a browsable directory or catalog for finding them. missing for 10: documented browsable app/connector directory, details of the install flow from that directory, independent hands-on corroboration of the current plugin experience.
